questions.question-one: Why do we wear a scout uniform?
questions.question-two: I am a new scout leader! Which training should I take first?
questions.question-three: I have lost my invoice. What should I do?
questions.question-four: What is included in my membership fee?
questions.question-five: How do I change my billing address?
questions.question-six: The amount on my invoice is incorrect. What should I do?
questions.question-seven: How do I change my contact details?

answers.answer-one: The scout uniform is a way for all of us to show that we belong to the scouts. It creates a sense of community, strengthens our identity and is part of our symbolic framework. Scout uniforms are used in different forms around the world and show that we are part of a global movement.
answers.answer-two: The first training you should take is Safe Sessions. This is the only mandatory training required to become a scout leader. Safe Sessions is an online course that takes about one hour to complete.
answers.answer-three: Send an email to support@scouterna.se with your name and membership number and you will receive a copy of the invoice by email.
answers.answer-four: Go to www.scoutnet.se, log in and change your billing address.
answers.answer-five: Go to www.scoutnet.se or contact your scout group.
answers.answer-six: Send an email to support@scouterna.se explaining why the amount is incorrect and include your membership number, scout group name and the current invoice.
answers.answer-seven: Log in to www.scoutnet.se to update your contact details.
